scope.source_manifest: exact 32 unique repositories; inventory.md/configs.tsv; main-revisions.tsv is current default-branch verification
scope.live_pr_scope: 12 repositories with baseline 78 open PR tuples
scope.remote_operations: read-only GitHub GraphQL/REST; no fetch, merge, rerun, dispatch, or writes

required_contract.branch_protection_endpoint: HTTP 404 Branch not protected for all 12; active protect-main rulesets are the contract
required_contract.required_contexts: requirements.json per-repository protect-main details; mostly DCO, Policy, ci-required; holla/holla-apt omit Policy
required_contract.app_ids: pr-checks.tsv and requirements.json observed check-suite app IDs; not inferred from actor/title
required_contract.approval_semantics: required_approving_review_count retained from ruleset; review observations are evidence only; external approval is not assumed

classification.method: check-run/status evidence on exact PR head; infrastructure/generator label is candidate only when Policy/DCO/ci-required or generator/workflow evidence is present
classification.no_unrelated_only_assertion: No PR is labeled unrelated-feature-only; rows mixing required/infrastructure and feature checks stay mixed/indeterminate.

main_verification.relation_rule: default-branch Commit.statusCheckRollup is exact main-head evidence; latest actions runs are auxiliary
main_verification.child_dispatch: Only event/head-SHA candidates recorded; parent run ID is not exposed by list-runs, so lineage is not inferred

handoff.g0_records: Use requirements.json snapshot_reconciliation, repositories.default_sha/open_pr_numbers, ruleset_contract, and main-verification.json.
handoff.checker: Use pr-checks.tsv for all 77 current rows; contexts_has_next rows are completed by context-pages.json.
handoff.category_workers: Use pr-checks.tsv failure_names/infra_failure_names/feature_failure_names plus exact details URLs; do not repeat fleet metadata audit.
